response.sql: WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind) SELECT at.tradekind as trader_type, at.record_count as count, (at.record_count * 100.0 / SUM(at.record_count) OVER ()) as share FROM analyzed_trades at ORDER BY at.record_count DESC;
